lines.zh: 我靠一排小管足慢慢挪。
lines.en: I move on rows of tiny tube feet.
My spines are long; I roll more than walk.

lines.zh: 谁推我都没用，我钉在这。
lines.en: Push all you like; I am pinned here.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟的斜坡下移。
lines.en: I creep down the trench slope.
An urchin walks one stop at a time.

lines.zh: 我的刺先碰到石头，再挪身。
lines.en: My spines touch first, then my body follows.
Deep-sea sand is cold and fine.
I squeeze past a stalk of kelp.

lines.zh: 别指望推动我，我抗得住。
lines.en: Do not expect to shove me; I hold firm.
I walk slowly, but my spines are loud.
The floor of the red meadow is flat.
I roll off a rock and snag my spines.

lines.zh: 我用管足抓住每一粒沙。
lines.en: My tube feet grip every grain of sand.

lines.zh: 走到哪，哪里就多一个坑。
lines.en: Wherever I go, a small pit remains.

lines.zh: 我伸脚试探，才肯往前挪。
lines.en: I test with one foot before shifting forward.

lines.zh: 沙地上我留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: I leave a shallow groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里，我慢慢侧着过去。
lines.en: I edge sideways through a crack in the reef.
The current pushes; I let it carry me.
Spines drawn in, I squat on a rock.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像颗黑刺球。
lines.en: Still as a black ball of needles.

lines.zh: 有片海带漂到我的刺上。
lines.en: A strip of kelp catches on my spines.
I grind my mouth slowly, chewing kelp.
Down in the deep, there is little sound.
My spines turn slowly on their own.
A few strands of weed hang on me.
No one is turning me over.
I count the currents in the trench.
A crab takes a wide path around me.
Every spine tip points outward.

lines.zh: 海底的石头被我磨圆了。
lines.en: The stone beneath me is worn smooth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吞下一小口海水。
lines.en: I swallow a small mouthful of seawater.

lines.zh: 安静地待着，刺也不乱动。
lines.en: Resting quietly, even my spines stay still.

lines.zh: 你的脚离我的刺太近了。
lines.en: Your foot is far too near my spines.

lines.zh: 我没有头可抬，只能感觉你。
lines.en: I have no head to lift; I just sense you.

lines.zh: 你手上那双靴子救了你。
lines.en: Those boots on your feet saved you.
Do not crouch and stare; it makes me tense.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的石头。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my stone.
I feel the water move; it is you.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有光，我这里没有。
lines.en: Your eyes have light; mine have none.

lines.zh: 你手里的镐子能敲开我吗？
lines.en: Could that pick of yours crack me open?
I tighten my spines and wait for you to leave.
Few visitors come to the deep.
Two spines snapped off; it hurts.
I cannot pull in; I just take it.
Hit me and my shell keeps a mark.
I have only two health; no more.
My spines bent; they must regrow slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从石上撬起来了。
lines.en: That pried me off my stone.
I do not retreat, but I still feel pain.
The deep is cold; my wound closes slowly.

lines.zh: 你打我的时候，手也破了。
lines.en: Hitting me cut your own hand too.

lines.zh: 我趴低一点，躲开下一下。
lines.en: I crouch lower to avoid the next blow.
That kelp in your hand — give it here.
I smell the green tang of kelp.

lines.zh: 你晃海带，我就慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Wave the kelp and I creep closer.
Not grass; I want real kelp.

lines.zh: 那片叶子落在我的刺上。
lines.en: That leaf landed right on my spines.
I am hungry; where is the kelp?

lines.zh: 你挪一步海带，我挪一步刺。
lines.en: You move the kelp, my spines follow.

lines.zh: 为了海带，我也能挪快些。
lines.en: For kelp, I can even move a bit faster.

lines.zh: 你把我引到石头上来了。
lines.en: You have lured me onto a flat rock.
This kelp will keep me chewing a long while.
You hit me; you are the one who bounces.

lines.zh: 我一步没退，刺倒是响了。
lines.en: I did not budge; only my spines rang.

lines.zh: 推吧，我抗得住所有力气。
lines.en: Push away; I resist every ounce of force.

lines.zh: 你的靴底被我的刺扎穿了。
lines.en: My spines punched through your boot sole.
We both stay exactly where we were.

lines.zh: 撞我等于撞一块带刺的石头。
lines.en: Bumping me is bumping a spiked rock.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我也不挪半寸。
lines.en: Even the current cannot shift me an inch.
You rub your foot; I slowly turn my spines.

lines.zh: 这一下磕得你手发麻吧。
lines.en: That must have numbed your hand.
I never dodge; I have never needed to.

lines.zh: 两颗刺球并排贴在石上。
lines.en: Two spiked balls pressed side by side.
The deep current is just right.

lines.zh: 我们的刺轻轻碰在一起。
lines.en: Our spines touch, very gently.
No bucket, please; we dislike buckets.

lines.zh: 卵会跟着水漂到海沟去。
lines.en: Our eggs will drift down into the trench.
I shift half an inch to make room.

lines.zh: 我们两个加起来也很重。
lines.en: Together we are still very heavy.
The kelp bed is our wedding hall.

lines.zh: 以后这片石头会有小刺球。
lines.en: Soon little spiked balls will cover this stone.
Be quiet; we are rather busy.
I hook a strip of kelp on a spine.

lines.zh: 这东西卡在我的刺中间了。
lines.en: This thing is stuck between my spines.
I cannot drag it; I push it along.

lines.zh: 谁把铁片丢在我背上了？
lines.en: Who dropped this iron scrap on my back?

lines.zh: 我顶着它，像戴了顶帽子。
lines.en: I carry it like a little hat.
Picking things up is hard for me.

lines.zh: 它压得我往前倾了一点。
lines.en: Its weight tips me slightly forward.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，把它运回去。
lines.en: Step by step, I haul it home.

lines.zh: 这块东西比海带硬多了。
lines.en: This is far harder than kelp.
I give up; it is simply too heavy.
There is a wide bed of kelp over there.
I feel the leaves moving.

lines.zh: 目标就是那片绿色的叶子。
lines.en: My target is that patch of green leaves.
Who touched my kelp?
I have turned all my spines that way.
Something is gnawing on my stone.
I turn slowly toward the smell.
That kelp is mine; do not take it.
Once fixed, I do not change my aim.
One target, one ball of spines.
I roll slowly toward the kelp.
Stand in my way and I will prick you.
I push the sand aside as I go.
The target is still, and so am I.
My spines arrive before my body does.
That smell is just ahead of me.
I roll over the rock, flattening the weed.
Move aside; I am nearly there.

lines.zh: 追东西的时候我不回头。
lines.en: Chasing, I never look back.

lines.zh: 海带就在我的刺下面了。
lines.en: The kelp is right beneath my spines.

lines.zh: 我的刺扎进你的手心了。
lines.en: My spine sinks into your palm.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，是你靠太近。
lines.en: I did not mean to; you came too close.
That will leave you swollen.
I am all points; do not grab me.

lines.zh: 你踩我，刺就从靴底进来。
lines.en: Step on me and spines enter your sole.
My charge is harder than a blade.
If it hurts, you did the bumping.
The blow is done; my spines still quiver.
Back off three steps and I stop.

lines.zh: 我在海底，从不主动出手。
lines.en: On the seabed, I never strike first.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的沙里冒出来。
lines.en: I rise out of trench sand.
Born with every spine already raised.
The seabed here is truly dark.

lines.zh: 我们两只挤在同一块石上。
lines.en: The two of us share one stone.
I test the sand with my tube feet.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋的碎片硌着我的刺。
lines.en: Spawn eggshell bits poke between my spines.
Deep-sea pressure suits me well.

lines.zh: 我慢慢找一个能吃的方向。
lines.en: I slowly seek a direction with food.

lines.zh: 这片红草甸的海底很暖。
lines.en: This red meadow floor is warm.

lines.zh: 我滚了一下，扎进了沙里。
lines.en: I rolled once and stuck in the sand.

lines.zh: 海水发烫，我的刺都软了。
lines.en: The sea scalds; even my spines soften.

lines.zh: 落下来的时候，我扎进了沙。
lines.en: Falling, I drove myself into the sand.
I breathe too, only very slowly.

lines.zh: 炸得我的壳裂了一条缝。
lines.en: The blast split a seam in my shell.

lines.zh: 箭弹开了，我的刺挡住了它。
lines.en: The arrow glanced off; my spines stopped it.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的刺发麻。
lines.en: Violet light makes all my spines go numb.
Every kelp stalk nearby is chewed bare.

lines.zh: 电流顺着刺钻进我身体。
lines.en: Current runs down my spines into me.

lines.zh: 没有水压，我的壳在发胀。
lines.en: Without pressure, my shell starts to swell.
